name: Kad
source:
The shy and sensitive middle brother, and the younger twin - Kad works as a janitor off stage. While he has a strong desire to perform, his stage fright and inferiority complex prevent him from doing so.
Food: Annin Tofu
Interest: Disco & Cleaning

Trigger: Anxiety
Gets Along: Sheep & Rabbit
Doesn't Get Along: Lion
